title: Wholesome Italian Pasta
description: A delicious and easy-to-make pasta dish with mediterranean flavors, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the wholesome olive oil over medium heat.
Add the stir-fry garlic and fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the meditteranean tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Stir in the zestful lemons juice and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Toss in the cooked pasta and chopped fry basil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
